description: Header file defining structures, macros, enums, and function prototypes for the Linux driver of Intel SmartPHY DSL PCIe Endpoint/ACA. It includes device info, hardware operations, and configuration parameters for the endpoint device.

methods.name: dc_ep_dev_num_get
methods.description: Returns the total number of attached endpoint devices.

methods.name: dc_ep_dev_info_req
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific endpoint device.

methods.name: dc_ep_dev_info_release
methods.description: Releases the reference to the endpoint device information.
